subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should the PR keep the legacy no-code missing-source runtime invalidation, or move that upgraded-state cleanup to doctor/migration before merge?
rationale: The explicit diagnostic marker follows prior maintainer direction, but the legacy fallback intentionally changes persisted SQLite registry upgrade behavior in a runtime path, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept Bounded Runtime Invalidation After Proof
options.body: Keep the legacy no-code branch if the contributor supplies redacted latest-head proof showing the upgraded SQLite row rederives and startup proceeds.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup To Doctor
options.body: Keep the explicit marker/schema fix but require legacy no-code cleanup to run through doctor or migration-owned code instead of steady-state runtime.

options.title: Split The PR
options.body: Land only the explicit-marker round-trip repair now and defer legacy upgraded-state handling to a narrower follow-up.

recommendation.title: Accept Bounded Runtime Invalidation After Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the legacy no-code branch if the contributor supplies redacted latest-head proof showing the upgraded SQLite row rederives and startup proceeds.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent gave the explicit-marker direction on the predecessor and currently owns nearby plugin registry/discovery history in the checked-out main.
